course_name: AI 機器視覺結合深度學習實作
outline:
使用 Python 3 帶同學理解以下主題，並請業師曾吉弘一同協助授課，建議具備Python基礎程式能力：
資料處理 / 深度學習 / 機器視覺
Use Python3 to guide students to understand the following topics, and ask the teacher Zeng to assist in teaching. It is recommended to have basic Python programming skills: data processing / deep learning / machine vision
